title: Scarlet
description: ScarletLifesteal is a unique Lifesteal Plugin aimed to make playing Lifesteal fun.
body:
# Scarlet Lifesteal
**Scarlet Lifesteal** is a unique, competitive Lifesteal plugin developed to make every PvP
fight matter. Along with the classic "kill for hearts" system, Scarlet adds a unique twist: every kill till the 5th rewards permanent potion effects. These boosts help you thrive, push harder, and dominate opponents. The system keeps gameplay fun, intense. Remember, in Scarlet Lifesteal - if you are strong, you will get stronger. Rule the servers, destroy them all.
# 
# Compatibility.
Supported Versions: 1.21.x (Paper, Spigot, Bukkit).
#
# FAQ:
1. How can I change stuff like Max Hearts and which Potion Effects are given on kills?
=> Edit the config.yml file.
2. Is the plugin fun to play?
=> Yes, it will be very fun to play with: your friends, a private SMP or even a Public Server.
3. Does the plugin cause high lag?
=> No, it is very optimized and causes minimal lag.
#
